QuestInfo.name: Can't Break Through!
QuestInfo.1: You don't know why, but you can't infiltrate the laboratory at the moment. #b#p3001100##k says she must find another method, and tells you to wait for now.
QuestInfo.2: #bTreglow's Laboratory#k is sealed with some kind of power.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 415,200
Can proceed to the Goodbye Seal quest

0.msg: Hmm... as expected, #rTreglow#k's locks are sealed with some very high-level chemistry.

1.msg: Looks like we won't be able to resolve this with brute force or magic. Hmm, I need some live samples.

2.msg: You know, #bGrandis's Shadowdealers#k are pretty well-versed in chemicals. Perhaps they could be of some service.

3.msg: Fortunately, #rTreglow#k was an important figure in the old days. There should be a good bit of documentation on his research and breakthroughs. I took the liberty of contacting #b#p3001104##k.

0.msg: I'll contact you when #b#p3001104##k's reagent is complete. He and his ilk seem to know their way around a cylindrical flask or two.
